scope: Read-only protocol/source/manifest/hash review; no model load, forward, backward, generation, score execution or weight payload read by reviewer.

static_checks.generator_weights: EXP67 uses validated scaling inference generator_state (not EMA), fixed step6000 and54ba75...state; SMALL/FULL fixed local200/global6200 inference exports. File identity and tensor-state identity checked; readout none, eval/frozen parameters; final unchanged-state check.
static_checks.diffusion_and_precision: Explicit saved z enters original free-only Euler50; canonical C checked through all51 trajectory states. Strict deterministic BF16 forward/FP32 parameters and integration, SDPA math, TF32 off.
static_checks.full_RAW_barrier: Three LABELS x48 verified RAW before any D0 model load/call; cached baseline results not substituted for these new noises.
static_checks.single_D0: Official fixed Chair D0 deliberately loads official EMA, one proposal per RAW. collect verifies model_forwards==1 and fixed checkpoint hash for all144 POST receipts.
static_checks.source_export: Restore canonical C before GEO_C; preserve source corner/vertex mapping; source winding restoration plus fixed-C free orientation. RAW and POST ordered-C contracts intentionally differ; no RBF.
static_checks.budgets: 144RAW,7200 generator forwards,144D0,288 RAW/POST scores; zero training/backward. No extra probes or adaptive checkpoint selection.
static_checks.ownership: One shared GPU_ALL_MODELS partition lock for generator and D0 across all three labels; run.py orders all generation before all POST.
static_checks.recovery: Verified completed cells reused. Existing incomplete cell/reserved call never silently replayed. Completed D0 proposal can be reused with raw/checkpoint/output identity.
static_checks.CPU_scoring: Original metric functions/scales retained; new labels/requests/query bindings only. C original ordering checked on POST; all8 AVMR/PMR settings, CF/FF/I and topology separate. No source-GT style rank.
static_checks.aggregation: Explicitly separate TRAIN_FAMILIAR andDEV_HELDOUT; average noises within parent/condition then across parents. Noise repeats are not independent parent samples.

CPU_checks.source_geometry_verification_scope: Reviewed explicit preparation checks of source corners/vertex IDs/partition, inherited CC/CF flags, positive source interface count and query-point ownership; no independent fresh geometry scan or NumPy regeneration in this audit.

corrected_reuse_traps.resource_guard_after_reservation: RESOLVED: G.partition marks post-cell phase after all-RAW verification; G.source checks resource before destination creation or D0 reservation.

memory.headroom: max(2048MiB,10% total device); load estimate additionally inflated1.2.
memory.live_checks: Each generator cell and each D0 cell boundary; no resource-triggered silent model retry.
memory.limitation: Allocator reserved/allocated are not full-process VRAM; 1GiB context allowance is an estimate and not a proof of hard6GiB process usage. Whole-device snapshots include unrelated processes.
memory.peak_counter_scope: Sampling resets per rollout and D0 per forward; any experiment maximum must aggregate all saved per-call/rollout receipts, not use only the final counter.

scientific_limits: Four familiar C were selected for a prior training-internal diagnosis and are not unbiased test examples.
DEV excludes67 parents/group/exact geometry andknownPAIR04 near-duplicate only; exhaustive shape-level uniqueness not certified. Official generator/D0 pretraining exposure UNKNOWN.
New full-N MT19937 draw then zero-known policy is explicit; sample receives saved z and does not redraw through make_noise.
Actual C adoption and whole-shape judgment require separate real image review; vertex proximity is not a topology certificate.
This is implementation approval, not evidence that any endpoint improves; no current scores or anonymous model mapping were read.

blinding.instruction: Keep annotations anonymous and save before reading model mapping or this experiment numeric outcomes.
